story.title: French Student Fined for Straw-Licking Prank in Singapore
story.summary: A French teenager has been fined $465 in Singapore after pleading guilty to a public nuisance charge related to a viral straw-licking prank. The 19-year-old expressed remorse for his actions, which have raised concerns about his right to remain in the country.

explore_lenses.label: Why did a prank prompt a criminal case?
explore_lenses.title: Hygiene disruption turned a stunt into public harm
explore_lenses.summary: The case was not treated solely as an online prank: the video created a potential food-hygiene concern and required the machine operator to take remedial action. Prosecutors characterized the offence as at the lower end of seriousness because no one was known to have used the straw.

claims.text: iJooz replaced all 500 straws in the dispenser after the incident; the reported replacement cost was S$5.
Prosecutors said hygiene had been compromised but that there was no evidence of harm because no member of the public used the straw.
iJooz said it planned machine changes including individually wrapped straws and compartments that open only after a purchase, according to reporting before the sentencing.

explore_lenses.label: How did the case reach a fine?
explore_lenses.title: A viral March video led to charges and a guilty plea
explore_lenses.summary: The incident on March 12 moved from an Instagram post to two criminal charges in April. At sentencing, he admitted the public-nuisance offence; the court imposed a S$600 fine rather than probation or a community-based sentence.

claims.text: He was initially charged on April 24 with mischief and public nuisance over the alleged March 12 act at Goldhill Centre, where he filmed the stunt and later posted an edited video to Instagram.
On July 30, he was fined S$600 after pleading guilty to public nuisance; Judge Kelly Ho said probation and a community-based sentence were not appropriate given his age and the nature of the offence.
The defence lawyer told the court that Maximilien was fully sorry for the trouble caused, while prosecutors accepted a fine proposed by the defence.

explore_lenses.label: Could he still remain in Singapore?
explore_lenses.title: His Student's Pass status remains the key unresolved issue
explore_lenses.summary: The prosecution delayed the earlier hearing specifically to obtain an immigration answer about the effect of a conviction on his Student's Pass. Singapore's immigration rules give the Controller discretion to cancel a pass where a holder breaches conditions or is considered undesirable, but no cited report confirms a decision in this case.

claims.text: On July 13, prosecutors sought an adjournment while checking with the Immigration and Checkpoints Authority whether a conviction would result in cancellation of his Student's Pass; the answer could affect sentencing.
He was expected to go to France from September through the end of 2026 for part of his ESSEC Business School programme, according to the court hearing report.

ICA's Student's Pass terms state that the Controller of Immigration may cancel immigration passes if satisfied that a holder breaches the conditions or becomes an undesirable or prohibited immigrant, and may require departure within 24 hours of cancellation.

related_stories.title: Ceuta Requests National Emergency Amid Surge of Migrants from Morocco
related_stories.summary: Authorities in Ceuta have requested Spain to declare a national emergency due to a significant influx of migrants swimming from Morocco. The local government is seeking military assistance as border security is overwhelmed by the number of individuals attempting to enter the territory.

related_stories.title: 150-Year-Overdue Book Returned to Australian Library After Being Found in Fireplace
related_stories.summary: A book titled 'Antiquities of Athens,' published in 1858, was returned to the Kiama library in Australia after being discovered bricked inside a fireplace during home renovations. The man who found the book reported it was inside a tea crate sealed within the wall. The return marks an estimated 150 years of overdue status.

related_stories.title: Iran Promises Retaliation After US Conducts Major Strikes in Response to Attacks
related_stories.summary: Iran has vowed to retaliate against the United States following a significant military response from the US, which included a 'heavy wave of strikes' targeting Iranian positions. This action was taken in retaliation for Iran's missile attack on US forces stationed in Jordan. The strikes mark a resurgence in hostilities in the region, complicating ongoing peace negotiations and drawing in Iranian proxies.

related_stories.title: US Conducts Strikes on Iranian Targets Following Foiled Missile Attack
related_stories.summary: The US has launched significant strikes on Iranian targets in response to an attempted missile attack on American forces. This escalation follows a brief period of reduced hostilities between the two sides, which have now resumed missile exchanges.
